sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: A shrub endemic to Phillip Island in the Norfolk Island group; plants are also cultivated for conservation on Norfolk Island. It reaches about 2.5–4 m.

sections.title: Flowers
sections.text: The pale cream to light green flowers have a magenta centre and become redder as they age. They differ from the large bright pink flowers of Mauritius hibiscus H. fragilis.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: No reliable food use is documented in the sources consulted.
